Verstappen wins the Singapore sprint ahead of Hamilton and Leclerc. Antonelli finishes fourth, with Lawson, Bearman, Hülkenberg and Norris completing the points.

Norris and Piastri collide at Turn 5 on the Singapore sprint's final lap. Piastri retires and Norris finishes eighth.

Russell crashed out of the Singapore sprint lead after passing Verstappen at the start. Hadjar retired with power trouble, while Colapinto's Alpine shut down during the Safety Car period.
